Every alt is "" (DESIGN-SPEC 11: decorative): pass attrs { "data-decorative": "" }. "phone" = a 1170x960 crop of the same master for 390x320 banners at DPR 3: pass it to ctx.img as a file ref. Files under assets/generated/real/ are the client's own photos with the background removed: no AI label (needs the PIPELINE exemption, see docs/IMAGERY.md). kind "video": ctx.video(id) is null until the loop files exist; render the still named in "still" then. The 404 banner is S-MIST (render404 has no page path).
